*Source: [The City of 7 Seraphs](https://www.drivethrurpg.com/product/269801/The-City-of-7-Seraphs?affiliate_id=549120)*

This page includes content based in and around the City of 7 Seraphs campaign setting from Lost Spheres Publishing. Many pieces of content from this campaign setting are more common among certain groups, though for ease of use, they've been arranged differently in this section than they appear in products from Lost Spheres Publishing. Some content in this section was previously published in products from Lost Spheres Publishing or other retailers.

Proper names from the City of 7 Seraphs are non-OGL content used by permission of Lost Spheres Publishing. Content specific to a location or organization was designed to be used within that frame and combining mechanics without regard to this may result in unintended balance issues. For more information visit: www.cityof7seraphs.com or www.lostspherespublishing.com.
